mode: retrospective shadow research; public-safe source references only

cases.finding: Result amended after inquiry; distinguish crossing order, official placing and settlement rules.
Execution incident and rider equipment loss should be separate fields; scheduled and actual off differ.
Trainer retrospective explanation of surface/code suitability is not pre-race evidence; equipment change status unknown.
Small-field novice graded race; compare actual terms and achieved figures rather than finishing order.
First attempt at longer trip illustrates unexposed stamina uncertainty; qualitative finishing strength is not a sectional measurement.

experiment.baseline: normalised inverse decimal odds at common pre-off freeze
experiment.challenger: race-normalised market offset plus regularised booking covariates; eligibility, claims, trainer volume, usual rider share, jockey opportunity quality, availability, code and class; unknown availability explicit
experiment.validation: rolling chronological race-grouped holdouts, training-only feature histories and shrinkage; paired race-level log loss, Brier, top1/3/5, coverage and calibration; report uncertainty and no gain until verified
experiment.outcome_policy: official final placing for sporting accuracy; settlement separately; retain crossing order for execution analysis; exclude unresolved inquiries until final

blockers: no complete timestamped market and runner histories verified
no official achieved figures or sectional pars
preservation: No changes to A/B1, live tips, ledger or scoring.
